coverage.ever_recommended_flag: none: corpus is the full priced universe (all mapped contracts), no recommendation filter applied

data_quality.mid_vs_ask_note: mid is (yes_bid+yes_ask)/2; thin books have mid far from either ask, so model-vs-mid 'gaps' there are not executable

discovery_validation_holdout.null_statement: no cell survived BH<=0.10 on discovery; holdout evaluated only for frozen cells; 3 weeks of data is a short sample

timing.note: observation-level price comparisons from ONE snapshot per label; no fills, queue or maker mechanics. Thin-book rows excluded.

limitations: ~3 weeks (weeks 1-3 of 2026), few hundred settled games: wide intervals; nulls are not proof of no edge
same ticker appears at up to 9 snapshot labels; rules use the first qualifying snapshot per ticker-side, clusters are games
acquisition price = executable ask in the snapshot; real fills (queue, size, slippage) not modelled
gap uses model - midpoint; thin books (spread>10c) excluded from EV/selection but shown in calibration without filter
unsettled markets (pending_not_final) are excluded from outcomes, never imputed
taker fee modelled 0.07*P*(1-P) ceil-to-cent per contract; estimated_taker_fee field compared in ev.fee_model_vs_field
